tasks.title: Discover and retain safe immediate-child project bindings
tasks.outcome: Read docs/plans/workflow-monitor-multiproject-tinyspec.md (requirements truth) and docs/plans/workflow-monitor-multiproject-tasks.md#shared-worker-brief. Preserve the existing graph/layout, Details, labels, metrics, status/acceptance, ordering/filtering, followups, pagination, freshness and 60-second run polling. No runtime/writer/schema/store mutation, migration/backfill, workflow control, aggregate view, recursive discovery, watchers, dependency/framework changes, automatic setup/install/deployment, or old --project/unscoped-URL compatibility. Preserve numeric loopback, closed DTOs/errors, fixed startup assets and canonical worktree/admin/store/metric identity protections; browsers supply discovered opaque refs, never filesystem paths. Change only owned paths for this outcome; preserve unrelated work. ADR-0003 (docs/decisions/ADR-0003-current-launch-authority-and-neutral-tasks.md): instructions are authorization-neutral; consume current launch authority from the runner, not historical phase labels. ADR-0004 (docs/decisions/ADR-0004-shared-routine-worker-permissions.md): bounded isolated Git/store fixtures and local servers need no routine reapproval; do not affect unrelated data/services or install missing prerequisites. Run specified checks with prepared tools, report actual outputs/NOT RUN gaps; failed isolation/safety proof blocks affected reliance, not a weakened criterion. Deliver workflow_monitor/projects.py: validate/expand/resolve a configured projects root without creating it; discover only regular nonsymlink immediate children that are canonical Git worktree roots, including linked worktrees. Reuse existing Reader/Git verification rather than duplicate its safety rules. Expose a small registry contract consumed by T002/T003: refreshing inventory produces deterministic label-sorted closed {ref,label} entries; opaque URL-safe refs remain stable for the same canonical child across polls/restart; resolving a discovered ref returns its retained project entry/Reader or a closed unknown/unavailable result. Retain Readers, including initial no-store bindings and unsafe/unreadable candidate qualification, rather than sharing/recreating them on refresh. Keep qualifying projects with unavailable stores listed and isolate candidate failures. Inventory refresh must not read every store snapshot. Revalidate directory/worktree/admin identity before addressed use; removed/replaced/retargeted bindings must not be silently rebound, including remove/recreate across inventory refresh. Root read errors are unavailable, not authoritative empty inventory. Add permanent actual-helper tests with tiny real Git roots/linked worktrees, not directory-list mocks as sole proof. Document discovery, binding lifetime and unavailable/empty semantics in canonical README. Exclude HTTP, launcher and browser changes; Reader internals remain unchanged.

required.pass_condition: Actual discovery includes canonical immediate roots, a linked worktree and no-store project; excludes nonprojects, deeper nested repositories and symlink children. Inventory is label-sorted with stable opaque refs across refresh/new registry; add/remove is observed on next refresh. Invalid/missing/unreadable/non-directory root has an actionable --projects-root diagnostic; empty root succeeds; root-read error is distinguishable from empty.
required.evidence: Permanent test_projects assertions using real temporary filesystem/Git worktrees; capture command output and example closed inventory.
required.permission: Bounded isolated fixtures/databases and numeric-loopback test servers allowed under ADR-0004; prepared dependencies only, no setup/install, paid/provider calls, deployment, unrelated data/service changes or routine verification reapproval.

required.pass_condition: Same child retains the same Reader across polls; no-store -> first legitimate store is readable by that Reader. Unsafe/unreadable child does not block healthy inventory/use. Removal/replacement/admin retarget cannot adopt successor data or reset pinned store/metric boundaries, including across disappearance/reappearance; no arbitrary input path resolution or observation writes.
required.evidence: Actual-helper identity/failure/no-store tests plus unchanged Reader safety regressions; compare fixture DB/metric bytes and absence of newly created .coherence for no-store observation.
required.permission: Bounded isolated fixtures/databases and numeric-loopback test servers allowed under ADR-0004; prepared dependencies only, no setup/install, paid/provider calls, deployment, unrelated data/service changes or routine verification reapproval.
